messages:
Maya: Quick check-in for the launch social queue: we need a LinkedIn carousel + 3 X posts (announcement, benchmark highlight, webinar reminder). Who can own carousel slides and the webinar reminder copy?

Ethan: I can draft the webinar reminder copy. Keep it concise and include timezone for the live Q&A. Also add registration CTA and a speaker name.

Priya: I'll build the carousel slides in Figma. Which stats should we highlight?

Maya: Highlight: 2.1x throughput improvement, 28% per-token cost reduction, and 99.9% 95thpct latency SLA on our dedicated config. Use the benchmark chart for slide 2.

Riley: For X: what cadence? Suggest: announcement -> benchmark thread -> webinar reminder (48h before). Buffer-bot will schedule.

Buffer-bot: Upcoming posts added to buffer queue in draft: 3 items.

Ethan: Draft X announcement: "Meet Redwood Inference: consistent LLM serving across hosted, dedicated, and private clouds. Webinar: Apr 2, 10am PT. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar #LLMops #AI"

Priya: Carousel plan: slide 1 intro, slide 2 benchmark visual, slide 3 quick config takeaways, slide 4 webinar CTA + speaker headshot. I'll add alt text.

Maya: Reminder: paid amplification on the benchmark thread only. Budget $250. Targeting: devs, platform engineers, infra managers. Riley set the boost.

Riley: Boost scheduled: 48hrs, $250, targeting set. Added UTM: ?utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_q2

Ethan: Webinar reminder copy (short): "Last chance: Join our webinar Apr 2 at 10am PT to see the inference configs that fueled 2x throughput. Live demo + Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"

Maya: Assign monitoring: Ethan monitors X replies first 12 hours, Priya watches LinkedIn.

Priya: I'll also respond to asks for slide deck link: template reply: "Thanks! We shared the deck post-webinar; sign up and we'll send the slides + replay."

Maya: Good. Any blockers on assets?

Priya: Need logos from design tokens file. Pinged design.

Maya: Ok. Let's reconvene if design doesn't deliver by EOD Monday.

Ethan: Cool, will finish copy and drop in the shared doc tonight.

Maya: Thanks team :tada:
